reviewContext.userProblem: Other systems need to verify their kickflow integration (REST API client and webhook receiver) locally and in dev, but kickflow cannot be contracted by individuals. punchflow is a dummy kickflow server whose behavior is inferred from public kickflow material (design-docs/references/kickflow-api.md and kickflow-openapi.yaml: 96 operations, 57 paths, 13 webhook events).
requiredOutcomes: Coverage matrix in design-docs/specs mapping every kickflow API operation and webhook event to its punchflow implementation, with inferred items marked (design-api-coverage.md)

Contract test loads design-docs/references/kickflow-openapi.yaml, asserts all 96 operations are routed, and validates a representative 200 response of every operation against its response schema (PF-26)
Every /v1 endpoint is implemented and covered by httptest Go tests checking status codes, response field names, pagination headers and error format (PF-18..PF-23)

All 13 webhook events are emitted by their lifecycle actions, signed with X-Kickflow-Signature sha256=HMAC hex, persisted with delivery attempts, and tested with an httptest receiver (PF-09, PF-15, PF-22, PF-23, PF-24, PF-26)
Approval engine tests cover submit -> multi-step approve -> completed, deny, send back and resubmit, withdraw, parallel all/any steps, and proxy approval (PF-14)

JSON fixtures under fixtures/default seed a realistic org, users, masters, forms and 3 workflows; punchflow can load, reset and export them, and export round-trips byte-identically (PF-06, PF-07, PF-16)
Keycloak docker-compose plus realm import, a documented manual OIDC login check, and OIDC callback/token validation unit-tested against a fake issuer (PF-07, PF-17, PF-25)
web/ builds with bun install && bun run build, bun test passes, and the built assets are embedded and served by the Go binary (PF-03, PF-11..PF-13, PF-16, PF-27)
go build ./..., go vet ./... and go test ./... pass; mise tasks for build, dev, test and lint exist and work (PF-01, PF-27)
README explains how to point an existing kickflow client at punchflow: base URL, token, webhook secret (PF-25)
Service-token X-Caller-Id impersonation, rate-limit-compatible headers/errors (disabled by default), and the documented error codes are implemented and tested (PF-01, PF-04, PF-05, PF-24)
nonGoals: Production hardening, multi-tenancy, billing, high availability
A visual workflow designer; workflow and route definitions are read-only fixtures with no edit API (DIV-05)
Formula evaluation (INF-21), sub-status, labels, pull-up and revoke (DIV-04), enforcement of restricted role scoping (DIV-08), invitation e-mails (DIV-02)
CSV import/export, audit log export, virus scanning, purge of unreferenced uploads (INF-26)
OIDC JIT provisioning, RP-initiated logout, refresh tokens, a Keycloak container in automated tests
Full CRUD UI for org/grades/roles/masters/categories/folders/proxies (read-only views per user-qa item 10)
constraints: Go module punchflow, go 1.25, cmd/ and internal/ layout per .claude/skills/go-coding-standards; every Go file under 1000 lines
SQLite only through pure-Go modernc.org/sqlite (no cgo), schema migrations in internal/store/migrations
Frontend: Solid.js + TypeScript under web/, bun only (bun.lock committed); no npm/yarn/pnpm commands or lockfiles
Dev-only shortcuts (local login, admin reset) only behind explicit flags/env vars; no real secrets in the repo; dev fixture tokens are intentionally low-entropy

impl-plans/README.md Shared Execution Protocol: edit only the declared writePaths/sharedPaths, fresh reads with sha256 hashes, intent snapshot, drift detection, frozen contracts (go.mod, go.sum, internal/model/*, internal/fixtures/types.go, web/package.json, web/bun.lock) outside their owners and PF-27, no git state changes, no go mod tidy before PF-27, no repo-wide gofmt, per-plan identifier prefixes in shared packages
Workers update only their own plan file Progress Log and never edit this dispatch manifest; PF-27's sharedPath impl-plans/active covers plan archiving only

Verification logs go to /tmp/<plan-id>-<step>.log per plan text, with exit status recorded; per-plan/per-attempt evidence goes under evidenceRoot tmp/punchflow-kickflow-dummy-s460/<planId>/attempt-<n>/ (git-ignored)
Wave-2+ workers never write ./punchflow or web/dist/app; web builds go to a temp --outDir
Run commands in the foreground; no detached or orphaned processes
designDecisionsAndRationale: Single binary: web/dist/app and fixtures/default embedded through embed.go with the all: prefix and .gitkeep anchors, so a fresh clone builds before the web build
Single SQLite connection (MaxOpenConns 1); every repository, presenter, engine and webhook function takes store.Querier and never *store.DB, to avoid deadlocks inside WithTx

Stub-first contracts: PF-10 pins the /v1 route table (96 ops in 16 handler files), the engine surface and the files store; PF-05 pins oidc.go; PF-09 pins payload.go; PF-16 pins the admin stubs. Later plans replace bodies only, which allows wide parallel fan-out

Webhooks use a transactional outbox: engine events are enqueued in the same tx, and the dispatcher delivers after commit with a 10 s timeout, 1 + 10 attempts, exponential backoff (10 s base, 1 h cap; INF-08) and auto-disable after 7 days of failures (INF-10). Signature is sha256=HMAC hex of raw json.Marshal bytes with HTML escaping (INF-33)
Webhook payloads reuse the API presenters (TicketDetail, Comment, TicketWithStep), so webhook bodies have the same shapes as API responses
The punchflow-only dev admin API lives at /admin/api (23 ops), separate from the kickflow-compatible /v1 surface
Browser SSO is a server-side BFF using authorization code + PKCE S256 via coreos/go-oidc v3 and x/oauth2; local e-mail login exists only behind --enable-local-login
Vite + vite-plugin-solid run through bun, because Bun's bundler has no Solid JSX transform; bun test covers pure TS modules only
Contract test uses santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema v6 + gopkg.in/yaml.v3 against the official OpenAPI 3.1 copy
Inferred behavior is recorded as INF-xx and deliberate divergence as DIV-xx in design-docs/specs/notes.md
intentionalTradeoffs: Shared stub files cross waves: PF-10 stubs are edited by PF-14/PF-18..PF-23, the PF-05 oidc.go by PF-17, the PF-09 payload.go by PF-15, the PF-16 admin stubs by PF-24, and the PF-03 pages by PF-11..PF-13. Each is declared in sharedPaths with an intendedEdit note
Transient same-wave compile breakage is accepted while shared packages are mid-edit; workers re-verify at the end, and PF-27 runs a serial final reconciliation
Frozen data contracts after wave 1: missing fields become reconciliation requests resolved serially in PF-27
Rate limiting is off by default (--rate-limit 0)
Keycloak login is a documented manual check; Docker may be unavailable
Admin UI for org and master data is read-only (user-qa pending-punchflow-defaults item 10)
supportedEdgeCases: Literal routes take priority over wildcards (/v1/users/lookupByEmail, /v1/tickets/tasks); a wrong method on a known path returns 404 endpoint_not_found, not 405
411 for HTTP/1.x POST/PUT without a length; invalid_content_type, invalid_json, payload_too_large and type-mismatch invalid_parameter
Pagination: perPage bounds, Link first/prev/next/last only when applicable, Total header; key[] array queries with optional bare values
SAT without/invalid/unknown X-Caller-Id; PAT ignores X-Caller-Id; invited, expired-invitation, suspended and deactivated users; tenant suspended/maintenance/admin_working modes; IP allowlist

Engine: serial and parallel groups with all/any (percent ceil), proxy approval with expired registrations rejected, send back to applicant or an earlier step, resubmit rebuilds steps but keeps the ticket number, route branch errorMessage, conditional skip/include steps, author_customizable and assignee_customizable approvers, none and confirm steps, comment-required rules, visibility (invisible_ticket)

Webhooks: 3xx/201/404/timeout count as failures, retries keep the same X-Kickflow-Delivery, manual resend uses the current secret, a persisted outbox survives restart, HTML-sensitive characters are escaped as kickflow does
Files: signed download URL expiry and tamper detection, client filenames never used on disk, standard plan -> upgrade_required
OIDC: state replay/expiry, nonce/audience/expiry mismatch, unknown e-mail, open-redirect-safe returnTo
Fixtures: strict unknown-key rejection, cross-reference validation, byte-stable export round-trip, atomic regeneration of fixtures/default only after a semantic-equality proof
outOfScopeEdgeCases: combinationType custom and fieldKey other_variable are rejected at fixture validation (INF-18)
Asynchronous org-chart jobs (synchronous only, INF-23); activation schedules (activationPlan null)
Integration objects (Slack, Chatwork, Teams, Google, kintone, CloudSign) are always null/[] (DIV-03, DIV-06)
Real kickflow rate-limit numbers beyond the inferred fixed 60 s window (INF-07)
residualRisks: S5-L1 (low): design-docs/specs/design-api-coverage.md:185 says 15 handler files while the Handler column names 16; PF-10 plans and checks 16. PF-27 may record the fix in its notes.md update
Completeness of the wave-1/2 contracts (model, schema, engine/files/route contracts); repairs go through PF-27 reconciliation
Network-dependent installs in PF-02 (go get) and PF-03 (bun install)
